# Trailblaze Prep

> Trailblaze Prep is an independent resource for Salesforce certification preparation: practice questions, section-wise exam weightage, and study guides for Admin, Developer, Consultant, Architect, and more. Browse by role and start free.

Key pages:

- Home: overview of certifications by role, FAQ, and certification path
- All Certifications: list of every certification with links to individual study pages
- Certification Path: recommended order and dependencies
- Become a CTA: information on the Technical Architect credential
- About: mission and content approach
- Contact: email and WhatsApp

Each certification page includes: official exam name and code, section weightage, study plan, sample practice questions, related certifications, and FAQ.
